title: 12 V 5 W incandescent lamp on a base

sources.citation: UN ECE Regulation No. 37 (filament lamps for power-driven vehicles), category W5W: a 12 V wedge-base signal lamp whose 5 W is defined at R37's 13.5 V test voltage. Taking 5 W at 12 V (ratedPowerW at ratedVoltageV) is a game-design simplification. Only the rated values are used; the regulation's text and data sheets are not reproduced.
game-design: the lamp stands in a holder on a 50 × 50 mm base, 60 mm tall, with a screw terminal on each side of the base; not modelled on a product.
